\[f(n)= egin{cases}n/2, & n 	ext{ even},\3n+1, & n 	ext{ odd}.\end{cases}\]

steps.domain_action: Initialize the system with an arbitrary positive integer n.
Establish the critical threshold where the system operates with scale-free sensitivity.
Branch the trajectory based on the parity of n.
Execute the even branch where n is replaced by n/2.
Advance the state forward in time along the halving path.
Record the halving operation as a permanent step in the trajectory.
Execute the odd branch where n is replaced by 3n+1.
Trace the theoretical descent required to balance the expansion of the odd branch.
Maintain the asymmetric dynamics where both reduction and expansion coexist.
Compose the current state with the next iteration of the function.
Re-evaluate parity for the new integer value.
Apply halving if the new value is even.
Advance the state along the reduction path.
Record the second halving operation.
Apply tripling-plus-one if the new value is odd.
Trace the descent path for the expanded value.
Hold the contradiction of expansion and reduction active.
Chain the operations to form the full trajectory.
Rejoin the even and odd branches at the convergence point.
Anchor the system in the fixed point cycle 1→4→2→1.
Confirm the self-referential closure of the cycle.
Fix the final state as the universal attractor for all inputs.
